mapper.select: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(amount), 0) FROM fin_bill WHERE kind = #{billKind} AND partner_id = #{partnerId} AND bill_date < #{date}
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(amount + discount_amount), 0) FROM fin_settlement WHERE kind = #{settleKind} AND partner_id = #{partnerId} AND status = 'APPROVED' AND settle_date < #{date}
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(amount), 0) FROM fin_advance WHERE kind = #{settleKind} AND partner_id = #{partnerId} AND advance_date < #{date}

SELECT t.biz_date AS "bizDate", t.type AS "type", t.doc_no AS "docNo", t.source_type AS "sourceType", t.source_no AS "sourceNo", t.amount AS "amount", t.remark AS "remark" FROM ( SELECT b.bill_date AS biz_date, 'BILL' AS type, 1 AS seq, b.bill_no AS doc_no, b.source_type AS source_type, b.source_no AS source_no, b.amount AS amount, b.remark AS remark, b.id AS id FROM fin_bill b WHERE b.kind = #{billKind} AND b.partner_id = #{partnerId} AND b.bill_date >= #{begin} AND b.bill_date <= #{end} UNION ALL SELECT s.settle_date, 'SETTLEMENT', 2, s.settle_no, s.method, NULL, s.amount + s.discount_amount, s.remark, s.id FROM fin_settlement s WHERE s.kind = #{settleKind} AND s.partner_id = #{partnerId} AND s.status = 'APPROVED' AND s.settle_date >= #{begin} AND s.settle_date <= #{end} UNION ALL SELECT a.advance_date, 'ADVANCE', 3, a.advance_no, a.method, NULL, a.amount, a.remark, a.id FROM fin_advance a WHERE a.kind = #{settleKind} AND a.partner_id = #{partnerId} AND a.advance_date >= #{begin} AND a.advance_date <= #{end} ) t ORDER BY t.biz_date, t.seq, t.id
mapper.sql:
SELECT s.partner_id, COALESCE(c.code, sp.code) AS partner_code, COALESCE(c.name, sp.name) AS partner_name, u.nickname AS owner_name, s.opening, s.bill_balance, 0 - s.advance AS advance_balance, s.bad_debt, s.opening + s.bill_balance - s.advance AS net FROM ( SELECT x.partner_id, SUM(x.opening) AS opening, SUM(x.bill_balance) AS bill_balance, SUM(x.advance) AS advance, SUM(x.bad_debt) AS bad_debt FROM ( SELECT b.partner_id, CASE WHEN b.source_type = 'MANUAL' THEN b.amount - b.settled_amount ELSE 0 END AS opening, CASE WHEN b.source_type = 'MANUAL' THEN 0 ELSE b.amount - b.settled_amount END AS bill_balance, 0 AS advance, b.bad_debt_amount AS bad_debt FROM fin_bill b WHERE b.kind = #{q.kind} AND b.partner_id = #{q.partnerId} UNION ALL SELECT a.partner_id, 0, 0, a.amount - a.used_amount, 0 FROM fin_advance a WHERE a.kind = #{settleKind} AND a.used_amount <> a.amount AND a.partner_id = #{q.partnerId} ) x GROUP BY x.partner_id ) s LEFT JOIN scm_customer c ON #{q.kind} = 'AR' AND c.id = s.partner_id LEFT JOIN scm_supplier sp ON #{q.kind} = 'AP' AND sp.id = s.partner_id LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON u.id = c.owner_id WHERE 1 = 1
AND (c.code LIKE CONCAT('%', #{q.keyword}, '%') OR c.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{q.keyword}, '%') OR sp.code LIKE CONCAT('%', #{q.keyword}, '%') OR sp.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{q.keyword}, '%'))
AND c.owner_id = #{q.ownerId} AND (s.opening <> 0 OR s.bill_balance <> 0 OR s.advance <> 0)
mapper.select: SELECT r.* FROM () r ORDER BY r.net DESC, r.partner_id

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(r.opening), 0) AS opening, COALESCE(SUM(r.bill_balance), 0) AS bill_balance, COALESCE(SUM(r.advance_balance), 0) AS advance_balance, COALESCE(SUM(r.bad_debt), 0) AS bad_debt, COALESCE(SUM(r.net), 0) AS net FROM () r
